questions.prompt: Which policy permits element access functions to be interleaved, but only on the calling thread?

`std::execution::seq`

questions.explanation: `unsequenced_policy`, added in C++20, keeps all invocations on the calling thread but leaves them unsequenced with respect to each other, which allows vectorization. `par_unseq` also allows interleaving but adds multiple threads. `seq` and `par` both keep invocations on one thread indeterminately sequenced, meaning they never overlap.
